sunforge-default.text: No generic cyberpunk neon, clean chrome sci-fi, supernatural glow around people, fantasy prophecy or chosen-one imagery, visible probability fields, scientific diagrams used to explain the mystery, transportation/infrastructure/process-improvement drama as the story engine, beige filler, or promotional/cover typography on story pages.
